citations.short: Sanitation--buildings not clean, free of infestation
citations.long: Buildings used in the manufacture, processing, packing or holding of drug products are not free of infestation by rodents, birds insects, and other vermin.

citations.short: Control procedures to monitor and validate performance
citations.long: Control procedures are not established which monitor the output and validate the performance of those manufacturing processes that may be responsible for causing variability in the characteristics of in-process material and the drug product.

citations.short: Sample size - test intervals
citations.long: The written stability program for drug products does not include sample size based on statistical criteria for each attribute examined to assure valid estimates of stability.

citations.short: Procedures not  in writing, fully followed
citations.long: The responsibilities and procedures applicable to the quality control unit are not in writing.

citations.short: Quality Control Review
citations.long: Complaint procedures are deficient in that they do not include provisions that allow for the review and determination of an investigation by the quality control unit.

citations.short: Biological product deviation report
citations.long: Failure to submit a biological product deviation report within 45 days from the date you acquired information suggesting that a reportable event occurred.

citations.short: Design verification - output does not meet input requirement
citations.long: Design verification does not confirm that design output meets design input requirements.

citations.short: Purchasing controls, Lack of or inadequate procedures
citations.long: Procedures to ensure that all purchased or otherwise received product and services conform to specified requirements were not implemented.

citations.short: Lack of or inadequate procedures
citations.long: The procedures for implementing corrective and preventive actions were not complete and implemented.

citations.short: Procedures for sterile drug products
citations.long: Procedures designed to prevent microbiological contamination of drug products purporting to be sterile are not written.

citations.short: Scientifically sound laboratory controls
citations.long: Laboratory controls do not include the establishment of scientifically sound and appropriate test procedures designed to assure that in-process materials conform to appropriate standards of identity, strength, quality and purity.

citations.short: Written record of investigation incomplete
citations.long: Written records of investigations into the failure of a batch or any of its components to meet specifications do not always include the conclusions and follow-up.

citations.short: Review of representative number of batches
citations.long: Written procedures are not followed for evaluations conducted at least annually to review records associated with a representative number of batches, whether approved or rejected.

citations.short: Complaints reviewed by Quality Control Unit
citations.long: Written procedures describing the handling of complaints do not include provisions for review by the quality control unit of any complaint involving the possible failure of a drug product to meet any of its specifications and a determination as to the need for an investigation of any unexplained discrepancy.
